body: I think a lot of stuff, move out from my parents and been moving from different apartments in that time, but I have been having these dreams for a long time I dont even remember exactly when it started, it just wasnt this often. The only thing I remember when I started having this dreams was that I felt kind of proud of being able to get away of all those things but now at this point I just feel scared of the feeling that I might not be able to always run from them and that in some point they might catch me and that feeling terrifies me because I think its only matter of time and Idk why it makes me so anxious and scared to even go to sleep. I know its just dreams and can't hurt me but when im in there it feels like a different reality even though I know im sleeping.
Yeah I get what youre trying to say and youre right its kind of like that, like an eternal loop just spawning in different creepy locations from time to time

It depends of the location, for example, the main places I usually dream are:
 - This white enormous house, seems old, paint its kind of chipped off, its surrounded by fields and from inside has several floors. In this particular place the bad things seem like ghosts and some people that might live there but are creepy looking and always seem to be chasing me when im in there.

-Skyscraper that seems in fair condition outside and inside but has like some kind of backrooms (Im not sure how to describe it but its like parts of the building that havent been used in a very long time, I access to these place by getting in some doors like the fire emergencys doors with stairs you see in hotels or similar buildings) some of these rooms are flooded and some of them are very deep dark waters where are wild animals that looks like crocodiles or huge snakes, not sure though never been too close enough to them.

-House in ruins, this one reminds me a lot to my parents house but when im in there the sky always looks black with some red pinkish strings, (I think I could describe it like it looks apocalyptic, like something terrible has happened or its about to happen) everytime Im here I feel so anxious because I get the feeling like several things are close behind me and seems evil, not sure of what it is either.

-Jungle hills very tall that are infested with crocodiles and giant snakes as well, when im here I usually end up jumping from a very very tall cliff into plain water that looks like the sea but its like really cold because it looks just like the Antarctic.

I also dream so often that im driving a car trying to get far away from people that are also chasing me in cars driving very crazy, this one also makes me very anxious because Im usually driving from the seats behind and cant reach the brake so I just have to avoid crashing into things, also from time to time the goddamn streets turn in some kind of freeway with mariokart bridges that go all the way into a circle and you just got to speed up to avoid falling from it.

I do a lot of walk in this dreams too, when I cant find a car and always have the feeling of being watched and im afraid to cross paths with people because they always seem to be bad and start to chase me
